item.title: Press release: AT&T announces $250bn commitment to advance US connectivity
item.description: 10th March 2026 – AT&T (NYSE: T) is proud to announce an investment and spend of more than $250 billion in the future of U.S. advanced connectivity, building the high-speed networks and resilience required for the next era of innovation and economic growth. The post Press release: AT&T announces $250bn commitment to advance US connectivity first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Legacy finance systems are stifling billion-dollar businesses, halting global expansion and increasing fraud risk
item.description: 10th March 2026 – US businesses are 5x more likely to pay fines, 7x more susceptible to fraud, and 9x more likely to uncover non-compliance in audits than their European counterparts, hindering business growth and expansion, according to a new survey from Basware, the global leader in Invoice Lifecycle Management. The post Press release: Legacy finance systems are stifling billion-dollar businesses, halting global expansion and increasing fraud risk first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: US non-farm payrolls: jobs data shock
item.description: 6th March 2026 – Isaac Stell, Investment Manager at Wealth Club: “The US economy appears to have stumbled in February, as a surprise decline in payrolls challenges the narrative of a resilient labour market.” The post Press release: US non-farm payrolls: jobs data shock first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: 44% of banks behind on ISO 20022 readiness for November 2026
item.description: 5th March 2026 – Despite committing millions of dollars and expanding specialist delivery teams to meet the November 2026 ISO 20022 deadlines, nearly half of banks (44%) are still behind schedule, according to new research from RedCompass Labs. The post Press release: 44% of banks behind on ISO 20022 readiness for November 2026 first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: African Development Bank Group (AfDB) unveils Africa-wide aviation financing platform to turn growth into sustainable profit
item.description: 5th March 2026 – With Africa poised to become the world’s fastest-growing aviation market, policymakers and industry leaders are focused on a central challenge: how to translate rising demand into sustainable connectivity, competitiveness, and financial viability. The post Press release: African Development Bank Group (AfDB) unveils Africa-wide aviation financing platform to turn growth into sustainable profit first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Swift accelerates transformation of consumer payments as banks roll out new framework for retail transactions
item.description: 5th March 2026 – Consumers and small businesses receiving payments in a range of countries, including five of the world’s largest remittance markets, will be among the first to benefit as Swift and banks globally roll out a pioneering new framework to bring next generation speed and new levels of affordability and predictability to cross-border retail payments. item.title: Canada’s RTR enters resilience, security testing
item.description: Payments Canada has provided an update on the nation’s real-time rail rollout, with work in the first quarter of 2026 focused largely on resilience and anti-fraud capabilities. Acceptance testing is ongoing, and the organisation says more payment service providers have enrolled. The post Canada’s RTR enters resilience, security testing first appeared on Treasury Today.
